title: justicia genistifolia subsp. australe
intro: Justicia genistifolia subsp. australe, commonly known as Australian Justicia, is a plant species belonging to the family Acanthaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that may help alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Australian Justicia include its ability to relax the respiratory system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
